action.title: Action
action.description: REQUIRED. Operation: remember | recall | search | forget | context_pack

memoryStoreId.title: Memory store ID
memoryStoreId.description: REQUIRED. Stable id for your named key-value store (e.g. my-github-user~stripe-integration). Same id across sessions = persistent memory.

url.title: URL
url.description: Page URL for remember, recall, or context_pack. Normalized for matching.

content.title: Memory content
content.description: Text to save when action is remember.

query.title: Search query
query.description: Keywords for search or to rank context_pack results.

memoryId.title: Memory ID
memoryId.description: UUID of a single memory (forget, or remember update if provided).

maxTokens.title: Max tokens (estimate)
maxTokens.description: Approximate token budget for context_pack markdown.

title.title: Memory title
title.description: Short descriptive title for this memory.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Optional tags to help categorize this memory.

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: Estimated confidence (0.0 - 1.0) in the memory's accuracy.
